Rinse and repeat, with always the same weapon upgrade. Oh, and pixel art looks like it was made in MS Paint. [/i] + Three different layers of progression (1 in-run, 2 permanent) + You can gain money when the game is closed. + There is a definite end, and a real endgame with modifiers. - One of the main problems is that you constantly have to babysit the game, since the money gains are exponential and you really have to click on the same "improve weapon" button every few minutes. - For the same reason, gaining money offline only leads to small progress. - You have 5 weapon types and you can choose 2 of them for your run. It doesn't favor experimentation at all: since your prestige points are precious, you wanna focus on one weapon. - Even if you can have 2 weapons, you just wanna improve one during a run since the other one is so weak. - The quarantine (endgame) mechanic with modifiers is just as boring as the rest of the game, sadly. - Pixel "art" is not art, it looks really amateur. *What do you call an invisible protocol droid? I don't know what people are fussing about in the negative reviews. It is a clicker game. You click a lot, because that is what you are supposed to do. When you want to farm resources, you just leave it idle. It is a very straightforward minimalist tower defense and incremental experience for when I just want something simple and casual. However, I do want to mention that the save game feature doesn't work properly right now. When you leave the game randomly or click manual save, even when it clearly shows the cloud saving icon, it won't actually save your progression. Once you reopen the game, you will return to level 1 again. Thankfully, the points you accumulate will remain, so it isn't a total loss, but it is definitely an annoying glitch. On a positive note, the developer is incredibly responsive. I was mentioning these bugs in the discussion forum, and within minutes, the developer was able to find the issue almost immediately. Consider this a mixed review, since the platform only lets you choose recommend or not recommend. I gave it a recommend knowing the developer is very active and actively working on resolving issues.
